name: No recovery on first turn; next movement click changes 6/12 to 7/12, double click does not heal again
Three players wait for complete round; each hero heals independently
Building without movement heals before +2 maximum HP and advances the turn
Area merger without movement heals once; building and merging cannot repeat recovery
Movement then valid building grants no second recovery in same round
Trade that hands over turn heals only the initiator, once
Trade without handoff or without another hero does not heal
Recovery caps at max and is consumed even at full HP; no stockpiled healing
Recovery precedes poison/burning; bleeding does not tick outside combat
Dungeon exit heals once; bonus exploration turn grants no second recovery
Combat, dead heroes and offturn players cannot receive round recovery
